answer_1.quote: The objective is to improve the translation of the input text by leveraging the accompanying video's multimodal context.

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU, COMET and BLEURT as automatic evaluation metrics to assess translation quality.

answer_4.quote: We also randomly selected 50 outputs from each test set generated by Qwen2.5-VL-7B and MiniCPM-V 2.6 ... for human evaluation. The evaluators were computer science PhD students who are native Chinese speakers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare the two translations and indicate which one they preferred (win/tie/lose).
